description: This file defines a UI component 'GoalsFragment' which extends DialogFragment. It is used to present and edit fitness goal data such as weekly workouts and target calories per week, displaying a dialog with input fields, retrieving current goals from MockRepository, and updating the data based on user input.

classes.name: GoalsFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment subclass used to present and update fitness goals through a dialog interface.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns a dialog for editing fitness goals, initializing UI with current goal data and handling user update actions.
